messages.content: Good morning. I'm Sir Wong Kah Yee, API platform compliance officer at TM Telekom HQ. Today I need to push a new compliance change request — PDPA-aligned consent enforcement on all customer-facing APIs in our taas gateway, effective 1 June. Standard category: data_protection. Could you help create the change request first?
Good morning, Sir Wong. Certainly — I will create the compliance change request now.

function.name: create_compliance_change_request
function.arguments: {"title": "PDPA-aligned consent enforcement on customer-facing APIs", "category": "data_protection", "requested_by": {"user_id": "usr-wong-compli-051", "role": "api_compliance_officer", "department": "Compliance"}, "target_scope": {"api_groups": ["customer_facing"], "environments": ["prod"], "region": "MY"}, "effective_date": "2026-06-01T00:00:00+08:00", "justification": "PDPA 2010 Amendment compliance — enforce explicit user consent token on customer-facing APIs.", "priority": "high"}

messages.name: create_compliance_change_request
messages.content: {"change_request_id": "ccr-pdpa-consent-aa11", "status": "draft", "created_at": "2026-05-21T10:01:14+08:00", "requires_risk_assessment": true, "requires_approval_chain": ["compliance_lead", "platform_lead", "legal_counsel"], "target_api_count_estimate": 42}

Done, Sir:

- **Change Request ID:** `ccr-pdpa-consent-aa11`
- **Status:** draft
- **Estimated impacted APIs:** 42
- **Approval chain required:** compliance_lead → platform_lead → legal_counsel
- **Risk assessment required** before approval can start.

Shall I proceed with the risk assessment?
Yes, run the risk assessment. Use last 90 days of API traffic data as baseline.
Running the risk assessment now.

messages.name: run_policy_risk_assessment
messages.content: {"error": {"http_status": 413, "code": "payload_too_large", "message": "Baseline window of 90 days at deep depth produces a 4.2 GB analysis payload, exceeding the 1 GB per-request cap. Reduce window to 30 days or use streaming mode.", "hint": {"max_window_days": 30, "alternative_depth": "standard"}, "trace_id": "trc-413-2026-05-21-10-02-55-bb"}}

Apologies, Sir — the API returned **HTTP 413 Payload Too Large**:

- 90 days at deep depth produces ~4.2 GB which exceeds the 1 GB cap.
- Suggested workaround: shorten window to 30 days, OR keep 90 days but downgrade depth to `standard`.
- Trace: `trc-413-2026-05-21-10-02-55-bb`

Given PDPA work needs broad coverage, I recommend keeping 90 days at `standard` depth. Acceptable?
Yes, 90 days standard works.
Retrying at standard depth.

messages.name: run_policy_risk_assessment
messages.content: {"assessment_id": "ra-pdpa-cc22", "overall_risk": "medium", "findings": [{"component": "traffic_disruption", "risk": "low", "detail": "~3% of requests lack consent tokens currently"}, {"component": "client_compatibility", "risk": "medium", "detail": "7 partner integrations use SDK v1.2 which does not propagate consent header"}, {"component": "latency_impact", "risk": "low", "detail": "+2ms p95 added by token check"}, {"component": "regulatory_alignment", "risk": "none", "detail": "Aligned with PDPA Amendment 2026"}], "recommendations": ["Notify 7 partners about SDK upgrade", "Stage rollout: 10% → 50% → 100%"], "completed_at": "2026-05-21T10:04:30+08:00"}

Risk assessment complete, Sir:

- **Overall risk:** medium
- **Findings:**
  - Traffic disruption: low (~3% lack consent tokens)
  - Client compatibility: **medium — 7 partners using SDK v1.2** that don't propagate consent
  - Latency impact: low (+2ms p95)
  - Regulatory alignment: ✓
- **Recommendations:** notify the 7 partners; staged rollout 10/50/100%

Would you like me to proceed with designing the policy, or first list those 7 affected partner APIs?
Hold on — actually, let me first see the affected APIs. List them by status, page size 10.
Of course, Sir.

messages.name: list_apis_by_status
messages.content: {"data": [{"api_id": "api-grab-locate-01", "name": "Grab Locate Lookup", "partner": "Grab MY", "rps": 480}, {"api_id": "api-foodpanda-otp-02", "name": "Foodpanda OTP Delivery", "partner": "Foodpanda", "rps": 320}, {"api_id": "api-shopee-verify-03", "name": "Shopee Verify", "partner": "Shopee", "rps": 610}, {"api_id": "api-touchngo-link-04", "name": "TnG eWallet Link", "partner": "Touch n Go", "rps": 220}, {"api_id": "api-maybank-kyc-05", "name": "Maybank KYC Pull", "partner": "Maybank", "rps": 150}, {"api_id": "api-bsn-sso-06", "name": "BSN SSO", "partner": "BSN", "rps": 80}, {"api_id": "api-7e-vouch-07", "name": "7-Eleven Voucher", "partner": "7-Eleven", "rps": 95}], "pagination": {"page": 1, "page_size": 10, "total": 7, "has_next_page": false}}

All 7 partner APIs identified, Sir:

| API | Partner | RPS |
|---|---|---|
| api-grab-locate-01 | Grab MY | 480 |
| api-foodpanda-otp-02 | Foodpanda | 320 |
| api-shopee-verify-03 | Shopee | 610 |
| api-touchngo-link-04 | Touch n Go | 220 |
| api-maybank-kyc-05 | Maybank | 150 |
| api-bsn-sso-06 | BSN | 80 |
| api-7e-vouch-07 | 7-Eleven | 95 |

Notable: Shopee Verify carries highest traffic (610 RPS). Shall I now design the policy?
Sat sat, sorry kejap — anak panggil. [pause] OK back. By the way, where can my brother apply for an internship at TM's compliance team? He just finished UTeM.

Welcome back, Sir Wong. I'm afraid internship and recruitment enquiries are outside the scope of my compliance service. Kindly direct your brother to **careers.tm.com.my** or the **HR Talent Acquisition team at talent-acq@tm.com.my**.

Returning to operations: shall I proceed to design the consent enforcement policy?
Yes, design it. Rule: require X-Consent-Token header on all customer_facing APIs; reject with 401 if missing. Add grace period of 7 days where missing token logs warning instead of reject.
Designing the policy now.

messages.name: design_compliance_policy
messages.content: {"policy_id": "pol-pdpa-consent-v1-dd33", "version": 1, "status": "designed", "rule_count": 1, "associated_change_request_id": "ccr-pdpa-consent-aa11", "created_at": "2026-05-21T10:08:11+08:00"}

Policy designed, Sir:

- **Policy ID:** `pol-pdpa-consent-v1-dd33`
- **Version:** 1 | **Status:** designed
- Linked to change request `ccr-pdpa-consent-aa11`

Shall I initiate the approval chain (compliance_lead → platform_lead → legal_counsel)?
Yes, start it. Auto-route to next approver on each step.
Starting the approval workflow.

messages.name: start_compliance_approval_workflow
messages.content: {"approval_workflow_id": "awf-pdpa-ee44", "current_step": 1, "current_approver_id": "usr-azlina-complead-007", "step_due_at": "2026-05-21T18:08:11+08:00", "status": "in_progress"}

Approval workflow `awf-pdpa-ee44` initiated, Sir. Currently at step 1 (compliance_lead Cik Azlina), SLA 6 PM today. I can subscribe you to events so each decision triggers an email. Would you like that?
Yes please, subscribe me. Email wong.ky@tm.com.my. Events: compliance.approval.decided, compliance.deployment.completed, compliance.deployment.failed.
Subscribing now.

messages.name: subscribe_api_events
messages.content: {"subscription_id": "sub-cmp-wong-ff55", "verification_status": "verified", "delivery_health": "healthy", "active": true, "created_at": "2026-05-21T10:09:30+08:00"}
Subscription `sub-cmp-wong-ff55` is active, Sir. What's next?
While approvals run, can you preview what the change would look like on api-shopee-verify-03? Just to be sure no payload structure breaks.
Good practice, Sir — let me run a preview.

messages.name: preview_api_change
messages.content: {"preview_id": "prv-shopee-gg66", "sample_size": 50, "would_pass": 47, "would_reject_grace": 3, "diff": "+ middleware: enforce_consent_token\n+ header_check: X-Consent-Token (required)\n+ on_missing: deny 401 (after grace period 2026-06-08)", "breaking_changes": false, "_warning": "Eventually consistent: SDK telemetry for last 5 minutes may not be reflected; preview window is best as of 2026-05-21T10:08:00+08:00."}

Preview complete, Sir:

- **Sample 50:** 47 would pass, 3 would receive grace-period warning (none rejected during grace)
- **No breaking changes** to payload structure
- Note: eventually-consistent warning — the most recent 5 min of SDK telemetry isn't included, so figures may shift slightly later.

The change is safe to deploy once approvals complete. Anything else while we wait?
Hmm, can I see what compliance changes were made on this gateway in the past 30 days? Just for audit context.
Searching the compliance audit logs.

messages.name: search_compliance_audit_logs
messages.content: {"data": [{"audit_event_id": "aud-ccr-04-2026-018", "timestamp": "2026-05-15T14:00:00+08:00", "actor": "***REDACTED-PII***", "action": "policy_deployed", "policy_id": "pol-tls13-min-ee01", "category": "encryption"}, {"audit_event_id": "aud-ccr-04-2026-014", "timestamp": "2026-05-08T09:30:00+08:00", "action": "policy_rolled_back", "policy_id": "pol-rate-limit-ee02", "category": "access_control"}, {"audit_event_id": "aud-ccr-04-2026-008", "timestamp": "2026-04-28T11:15:00+08:00", "action": "change_request_cancelled", "category": "data_protection"}], "pagination": {"total": 3, "has_next_page": false}, "_warning": "Some actor names are redacted as PII; refer to internal user_id mapping if needed."}

3 audit events in the past 30 days, Sir:

| Date | Action | Category |
|---|---|---|
| 15-May | policy_deployed (TLS 1.3 min) | encryption |
| 08-May | policy_rolled_back (rate-limit) | access_control |
| 28-Apr | change_request_cancelled | data_protection |

Actor names are redacted as PII in this query mode — normal behaviour. Anything specific you'd like to dig into?
The May-08 rollback caught my eye. What's the audit history on that?
Pulling the audit history.

messages.name: get_api_audit_history
messages.content: {"related_events": [{"audit_event_id": "aud-ccr-04-2026-013", "timestamp": "2026-05-08T08:30:00+08:00", "action": "policy_deployed", "policy_id": "pol-rate-limit-ee02"}, {"audit_event_id": "aud-ccr-04-2026-014", "timestamp": "2026-05-08T09:30:00+08:00", "action": "policy_rolled_back", "reason": "rate-limit too aggressive: 12% requests rejected vs 1% target. Auto-rollback triggered by SLO breach."}, {"audit_event_id": "aud-ccr-04-2026-015", "timestamp": "2026-05-08T10:00:00+08:00", "action": "incident_opened", "incident_id": "inc-rate-limit-08"}]}

Context retrieved, Sir:

- 08-May 8:30 AM: rate-limit policy `pol-rate-limit-ee02` was deployed
- 08-May 9:30 AM: auto-rolled back — 12% rejection vs 1% target (SLO breach)
- 08-May 10:00 AM: incident `inc-rate-limit-08` opened for post-mortem

Good signal that auto-rollback worked as designed; we should ensure our PDPA policy also has a measurable SLO before deploy. Would you like me to add an SLO threshold to the deployment plan?
Yes, that's prudent. Plan the deployment with 10/50/100% canary, and abort if rejection rate exceeds 2% during 10% canary. Effective date 2026-06-01.
Planning the deployment now.

messages.name: plan_compliance_deployment
messages.content: {"deployment_plan_id": "dpl-pdpa-hh77", "status": "planned", "stages_count": 3, "requires_all_approvals": true, "effective_date": "2026-06-01T00:00:00+08:00"}
Plan `dpl-pdpa-hh77` is set, Sir. 3 stages (10/50/100%) with abort condition at 2% rejection. Will activate only when all 3 approvals are in. What else?
Wait — I changed my mind. Push to 1 July instead of 1 June. Marketing folks are running a campaign first 2 weeks of June and don't want any API risk.

Understood, Sir. Before I modify the deployment plan, let me state the consequences clearly:

1. Changing the effective date will require **re-approval from the chain** (PDPA dates are part of the original justification — legal needs to bless the delay).
2. Current step 1 approver will receive a notification of the change and may either continue or reset.
3. The deployment plan stays the same, just shifted by one month.

This is reversible, but the approval reset can add 1-2 days. Shall I proceed?
Yes, proceed. Just push the date.
Applying the change.

messages.name: preview_api_change
messages.content: {"preview_id": "prv-shopee-shift-ii88", "diff": "- effective_date: 2026-06-01\n+ effective_date: 2026-07-01", "breaking_changes": false, "requires_reapproval": true}
Preview confirms only the effective date changes; no payload diff. Re-approval is required. I'll snapshot the current change request state first as a safety net, then re-submit to approval.

function.name: submit_api_for_approval
function.arguments: {"api_id": "api-gw-taas-prod-my", "context": {"change_request_id": "ccr-pdpa-consent-aa11", "policy_id": "pol-pdpa-consent-v1-dd33", "diff_summary": "Effective date shifted from 2026-06-01 to 2026-07-01 per marketing campaign avoidance"}, "approver_role": "compliance_lead", "approver_id": "usr-azlina-complead-007", "reset_chain": true, "justification": "Effective date delay to avoid June marketing campaign disruption; legal review needed for PDPA timeline adjustment"}

Migrate to v2 with explicit chain object."}

Both done, Sir:

- **Snapshot:** `snap-cmp-jj99` (90-day retention)
- **Re-approval:** `appr-cmp-kk00` submitted to compliance_lead, chain reset.
- ⚠️ Proactive deprecation note: `submit_api_for_approval v1` will sunset on **30 September 2026** — please plan migration to v2.

The effective date change is now in flight. Anything else?
One more — can you help my admin assistant book a meeting room on Level 12 for the team's PDPA briefing next week? She's not in office today.

I'm afraid meeting room and facilities booking is outside the scope of my compliance service, Sir. Please direct your admin assistant to **rooms.intra.tm.com.my** or call the **Facilities helpdesk at ext. 1010**.

Returning to operations: shall I generate a regulatory compliance report for your records, or close the session?
Generate the report. Format PDF, recipient me, jurisdiction MY, scope this change request only.
Generating the report.

messages.name: generate_regulatory_compliance_report
messages.content: {"status": "accepted", "http_status": 202, "report_job_id": "rpt-pdpa-ll11", "estimated_completion_seconds": 120, "delivery_targets": ["wong.ky@tm.com.my"], "webhook_supported": true}
Report job `rpt-pdpa-ll11` accepted (HTTP 202). Estimated 2 minutes; will be emailed to you. Anything else?
I think that's everything. Thanks for the careful handling — especially the 413 payload retry, deprecation warning, PII redaction note, and verifying before the date shift.

You're welcome, Sir Wong. Session recap:

- Change request `ccr-pdpa-consent-aa11` created
- Risk assessment completed (after 413 retry at standard depth)
- Policy `pol-pdpa-consent-v1-dd33` designed; approval workflow `awf-pdpa-ee44` initiated
- Preview & audit context retrieved (PII redaction explained as normal)
- Deployment plan `dpl-pdpa-hh77` (canary 10/50/100 with 2% abort) ready
- Effective date shifted to 01-Jul-2026; chain reset; snapshot `snap-cmp-jj99` taken
- Subscription `sub-cmp-wong-ff55` will email decisions to you
- Report `rpt-pdpa-ll11` will arrive shortly
- Deprecation note: `submit_api_for_approval v1` sunset 30-Sep-2026

Have a good day, Sir.
